title: Plan P2-006 data governance contracts
businessObjective: Make source-system telemetry minimisation and future retention controls explicit before AI OS persistence or workflow work begins.
technicalObjective: Write an exact finite design for P2-006 static data-minimisation, aggregation, and retention authorities, make its product packet executable-ready, and prepare a separately bounded exact validator-admission task; do not implement a contract, retention behavior, or storage integration.
assumptions: Raw page views, clicks, scrolls, and marketing telemetry remain in analytics source systems.
P2-006 is static Tier-0 design only; it does not delete, aggregate, archive, transfer, persist, or access data.
A separate task must admit the exact P2-006 validator before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Design one closed V1 structural authority/canonical finite policy/exact data categories, aggregation intervals, prohibited per-interaction persistence/queue/workflow/AI invocation, retention classes/actions/eligibility, protected audit/failed-attempt history, deterministic reasons/precedence, and a minimal private-authority semantic interface.

Raw telemetry stays source-only; only hourly/daily aggregates, essential booking lifecycle events, anomalies/incidents, investigations/recommendations, proposals/approvals/executions/outcomes, and required audit evidence are eligible.
Retention classification is non-authoritative: no deletion, aggregation, archival, transfer, storage integration, or external operation occurs; unknown/conflicting/malformed categories fail closed.
Core obtains committed authority internally and imports no storage/provider SDK, clock, environment, filesystem, queue, workflow, network, credential, or caller dependency.
Update P2-006 with exact artifacts/evidence/validator/tests/rollback/GOV-050+GOV-051 dependencies and create GOV-051 to admit only the exact shell-free literal.
No schema, policy, package, test, runtime, storage service, SDK, provider selection, guest data, production operation, or external call is implemented.
solEscalationTriggers: Any guest data access, data deletion/retention action, storage/provider selection, audit-history weakening, network integration, or product implementation is out of scope.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only GOV-050 design, future P2-006/GOV-051 packet preparation, state/memory/risk/evidence; preserve terminal records, ADR-0002, canonical sources, snapshot, and external systems.
